formulations.Polymer system Notes: High molecular weight poly(ethylene oxide) based solid polymer electrolytes. HP-PEO (high purity) synthesized with anionic initiator (1 ppm), MW ≈ 1×10⁶, smaller polydispersity than C-PEO. C-PEO (commercial, Aldrich), MW ≈ 900,000.
formulations.Transference notes: The transference number is determined from potentiostatic polarization measurements.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: apparent activation energy for the ionic conduction mechanism in both PEO–LiCF3SO3 systems is equivalent and shows the same dependence on the electrolyte salt weight fraction. For the two-phase domain the apparent activation energy is constant and equal to 0.7 eV.
formulations.Notes: Polymers dried under dynamic partial vacuum (5 mm Hg of Ar). Salts recrystallized in acetonitrile and dried under dynamic partial vacuum at 100–110°C.
formulations.Reference: D. Fauteux et al. / Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 923-928
